# 胎息經註--幻真先生

**ID:** KR5a0131
**Custom ID:** ZB5a0131

## Authors / Editors
- 幻真先生 注 9th cent 後期?
- DZJY  JY095 胎息經註  Taixi jing zhu				:can:

**Editions:** SJB, ZHDZ

## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

A three-folio late-Táng commentary on the one-folio *[DZ 14 Gāoshàng yùhuáng tāixī jīng](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR5/KR5a/KR5a0014)*, the "Book of Embryonic Breathing," transmitted as the work of Huànzhēn xiānshēng 幻真先生 ("Master Illusion-True"), a ninth-century specialist on respiratory cultivation whose real identity is unknown. The text is preserved in the *Zhèngtǒng Dàozàng* 正統道藏 (DZ 0130 / CT 130), 洞真部 玉訣類, and is appended in the same Dàozàng fascicle as two companion pieces, *[DZ 131 Tāixī bìyào gējué](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR5/KR5a/KR5a0132)* and *[DZ 132 Tàiqīng zhēnrén luòmìng jué](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR5/KR5a/KR5a0133)*.

**Abstract**

The compilers of the *Sìkù quánshū zǒngmù tíyào* 四庫全書總目提要 considered Huànzhēn xiānshēng to be the author of the root scripture as well, but the *Tāixī jīng* also circulates independently (see [DZ 14](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR5/KR5a/KR5a0014)) and in a slightly variant form in *Yúnjí qīqiān* 雲笈七籤 60.27a–28b; the commentary itself is found at YJQQ 60.14a–27a. Huànzhēn xiānshēng is generally identified with the author of *[DZ 828 Huànzhēn xiānshēng fúnà yuánqì jué](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR5/KR5a/KR5a0828)* (the surface character 幼 in the DZ edition being a scribal error for 幻), a major Táng treatise on embryonic breathing; an attached preface dates that work to the Tiānbǎo era (742–756), but the same preface circulates with [DZ 824](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR5/KR5a/KR5a0824) under a Dàlì era (766–779) date, casting doubt on the Tiānbǎo attribution. Farzeen Baldrian-Hussein, in Schipper & Verellen eds., *The Taoist Canon* (2004) 1:367–368 (§2.A.4.b, Respiratory Techniques), observes that the equation *tāixī* 胎息 = *nèidān* 內丹 on 1a and 3b, and the borrowing at 3a from *[DZ 825 Yánlíng xiānshēng jí xīnjiù fúqì jīng](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR5/KR5a/KR5a0825)* 17b, point to late-Táng or even post-Táng compilation, probably before the *Yúnjí qīqiān*. The frontmatter brackets composition notBefore 850 / notAfter 900.
